final: WITH country_counts AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) AS player_count FROM player_college AS pc JOIN player AS p ON CAST(p.player_id AS TEXT) = CAST(pc.player_id AS TEXT) GROUP BY p.birth_country), total AS (SELECT SUM(player_count) AS total_count FROM country_counts), averages AS (SELECT AVG(1.0 * player_count / total_count) AS mean_share FROM country_counts CROSS JOIN total WHERE total_count IS NOT NULL), above_average AS (SELECT c.birth_country, c.player_count, 1.0 * c.player_count / t.total_count AS share, c.player_count - a.mean_share AS excess FROM country_counts AS c CROSS JOIN total AS t CROSS JOIN averages AS a WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL AND c.player_count > a.mean_share) SELECT SUM(player_count), AVG(share), AVG(excess) FROM above_average
